message.reasoning_content:
need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The charge label list includes:

- 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票

- 非法行医
- Others: gambling, etc.

So we may need both charges: 虚开增值税专用发票... and 伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章.

It may encompass forging as part of the act. But the law distinguishes: 虚开增值税专用发票罪 (Article 205) vs. 伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪 (Article 277). In many cases, both can be charged if the invoices are forged. The examples: In the first example, they only used 虚开增值税专用发票... not also 伪造. The facts there also mention "虚开" but not mention forging. In this case, they explicitly mention forged invoices (伪造). So maybe both.

But the instruction: "Use the exact charge label strings shown in the section headers as your answer". The relevant headers: we have three sections: 虚开..., 伪造..., 非法行医. So we can combine them if multiple apply.

Thus answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章<eoa>
